stories.title: Singapore crush Uganda; USA outlast Denmark to stay unbeaten
stories.subTitle: World Cricket League Division Three
stories.seoTitle: Singapore crush Uganda; USA outlast Denmark to stay unbeaten
stories.summary: The Danes continued the trend of sides winning the toss and losing the match, becoming the ninth team in ten matches to do so at Division Three

image.caption: Hayden Walsh Jr glides a single through point to bring up his maiden half-century for USA
image.longCaption: Hayden Walsh Jr glides a single through point to bring up his maiden half-century for USA, Denmark v USA, ICC World Cricket League Division Three, Al Amerat, November 15, 2018

stories.title: USA hold off Oman to claim WCL Division Four title
stories.subTitle: WCL Division Four 2016, Los Angeles
stories.seoTitle: 2016 WCL Division Four final day round-up: USA hold off Oman by 13 runs to claim tournament title
stories.summary: USA defeated Oman in the final of WCL Division Four by 13 runs, becoming the tenth host team to win a World Cricket League tournament title
stories.byline: Peter Della Penna in Los Angeles

image.caption: The USA squad were graced by the presence of Sir Mick Jagger during the final at Woodley Park
image.longCaption: The USA squad were graced by the presence of Sir Mick Jagger during the final at Woodley Park, USA v Oman, ICC World Cricket League Division Four Final, Los Angeles, November 5, 2016
